Chapter 6

Herod’s Opinion of Jesus.

14a King Herod heard about it, for his fame had become widespread, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead; that is why mighty powers are at work in him.”

15 Others were saying, “He is Elijah”; still others, “He is a prophet like any of the prophets.”

16 But when Herod learned of it, he said, “It is John whom I beheaded. He has been raised up.”

The Death of John the Baptist.

17b Herod was the one who had John arrested and bound in prison on account of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip, whom he had married.

* [6:14–16] This is the only mention of King Herod in this Gospel.
